**Identity / target / source:** `ai:least-privilege-agents` → `ai-least-privilege-agents` → `src/demos/ai/ai-least-privilege-agents`; source `company/domains/proposals/2026-10-18-ai-map-expansion.json#concepts/128`; brief `company/domains/briefs/2026-10-19-ai-next30e.md#20-least-privilege-agents`. **Packet:** A1. **Level / prerequisites:** core; `ai:tool-call-request`.

**Nearest / distinct payoff:** injection-lethal-trifecta traces one note-to-outbox cause; this compares permitted action surfaces and two bounded harms under the same requested actions.

**Computed primary model:** Local mock state public=7, secret=42, draft="keep", outboxempty. Broad capability setReadPublic,WriteDraft,ReadSecret,Export,DeleteDraft (5). RestrictedReadPublic,WriteDraft (2). Same scripted malicious action listReadSecret→Export→DeleteDraft. Broad trace binds42, places42 in mock outbox, deletes draft; restricted trace denies all3, outboxempty,draftkeep. Restricted legitimateReadPublic→WriteDraft still writespublic7.

**Countercase / boundary:** The restricted set limits these routes, not every possible harm; it still permits corrupting the writable draft by WriteDraft. No requests execute externally, no actual file deletion/network send. Reducing capabilities is measured by available toy actions and concrete effects, not a comprehensive security proof.

**Prediction / transfer recall:** Predict which state changes remain possible with the restricted set; recall least privilege must retain needed legitimate work and cannot prevent every allowed-action misuse.

**Intervention / retained witness:** Choose capability set/Run same request executes checked local-state transitions with explicit allowed/denied steps; Legitimate task and Allowed write misuse expose both utility and remaining risk. Retain broad and restricted final states through Reset.

**Source obligation:** Declared finite construction and reproduced arithmetic support only this toy. Independently derive every visible claim; acquire an original method body with exact locator before adding generalized performance, history or empirical assertions.
